name: Applied Materials
description: Applied Materials sells a broad range of chip-making equipment (deposition, etch, ion implantation, inspection and more) to foundries, logic and memory makers. A smaller arm, Applied Global Services, sells spare parts, upgrades and service contracts on the installed base. Two customers made up 19% and 15% of FY2025 revenue. China was about 28% of revenue in the nine months to July 2026.
